triggerKind.description:
If a trigger is periodic, then periodicity is used to specify a period of time to trigger the transition after.
If a trigger is an automatic trigger, specify condition field on {@link StateMachineTransition}.

periodicity.description: Used for a `periodic` triggerKind. Specify how often you want this trigger to occur.

title:
Type to represent how a {@link StateMachineTransition} must be triggered.

@see StateMachineTransition#trigger
name: TransitionTrigger
